main_text.p: baria recusauit, sordidum enim ei oblatum panem fame etiam stimulante aspernatus est, in tantum dissimilis clarissimis illis Regibus & Ducibus, qui cruentas aquas & cœnolas; panesq; atros & cibarios assumpserunt.

Vitellius trifariam semper, quandoque etiam quadrifariam epulas dispertiebat, in ientaculà, prandia, cœnas & commessationes, qui- Duo mil-bus vt sufficeret, vomitibus vtebatur assidue, quod etiam Claudium factitasse reperio pinnâ & 7. mil-in os indita. Famosissimam illam verò supra hac auitialias Vitellio à fratre datam cœnam quis non vna cœnâmiretur, in qua duo millia electissimorum pi- apposita.scium, & 7. auium apposita traduntur? Pati- Vitellijnam Vitellii, cui faciendæ fornax in campis patinaexædificata est non minoris quam ducentis se-vnafistilisstertiis, hoc est, quinque millibus aureorum cō- quinquestitisse proditur, in qua scarorũ iecinora, Phœ- millibusnicopterorum linguæ & murenarum lactes auteorcommiscebantur; erat autem Phœnicopterus constitit.auis ratissima, & primum M. Apitii mensis & memo-cognita: Murenarum lactes etsi in ipso Italico rabiliormari frequentes reperirentur, nihilominus ab fuit pati-externis littoribus asportatæ gratiores vide- na s.bantur: à Carpathio enim sq;, fretoq; Hispa- pi tragœ-niæ petitæ sunt: Vnde manifestum euadit sor- di, quæ s.didissimæ & profusissimæ Vitellium fuisse vi- millibustæ, cum nouies millies sestertium paucis eum coronato-mensibus interuertisse, Tacitus autor sit. rum ste-

page.notes: Right-margin notes are small italic and partly cut off at the margin; their readings are doubtful and marked with [?] where uncertain. Running head and page number read as printed but are uncertain at the scan's edge. Catchword "uexit" is the second part of the hyphenated word "in-uexit" at the page foot. Several marginal words are fragmentary and transcribed as far as legible. Parts of the second paragraph's sentences in the lower right are blurred and may contain misreadings.
